verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents choosing a storage region or data-residency location for Egnyte-hosted data. The only related item is hybrid storage, which connects on-premises, NAS and public cloud storage through one namespace. That is a unified-access feature, not a documented region or residency choice, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
